scientific_integrity: Complete analytic finite-population proof; small exact rational computations supplement but do not establish universal quantification. Mathematical methods are standard; model-specific consequence is assessed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to active-hyperedge event counts, not arbitrary attempted updates.
The update rule is proportional unanimous group adoption, not majority group influence.
Absorption may be a fragmented mixed state instead of global consensus.
Physical time assumes unit-rate Poisson clocks per active hyperedge.
Publication priority has not been independently established.
title: A sharp quadratic interaction budget for adaptive proportional hypergraph voting
